text_block_list.text:
While walking near the track, I overheard 
someone talking.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaa~~... You've really done a number on 
these...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But I got a new hardener! I'll fix 'em 
right up for ya!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ugh... my bad... ...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, how'd they end up like this anyway? 
Aren't you usually super good at nail 
care?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Well... it's completely due to my lack of 
self-management...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—...Lately, I've just been off. It feels 
like the gap between me and everyone else 
keeps widening.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So I pushed myself harder than usual in 
training. And then... my self-care 
couldn't keep up.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I tried out different care products, 
managed my meals strictly, and made sure 
to sleep and wake up early, but—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even with all that, it wasn't enough at 
all... I need to get my act together.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That doesn't sound 'not enough' at 
all?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like, aren't you being way too 
amazing~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, managing meals is super hard! All 
I ever want is junk food!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Early to bed, early to rise is even 
harder! Just not being late is already a 
struggle for me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And checking care products on top of that? 
You're basically guaranteed the Best 
Effort Award, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, no, but... it's really nothing 
worthy of praise at all...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way, it's seriously awesome! I could 
never do all that!

Tosen Jordan probably doesn't even intend 
it. Yet that's precisely why her feelings 
get through so well.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, congrats on your award! Let's get to 
work! Here, take off your socks!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...! It hardened so cleanly...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: See? Looks like training's good to go too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Hey, you over there, mind 
taking a look?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. How's it look from a Trainer's 
perspective? Think running on this is 
fine?

I examined Win Variation's nails. They 
were nicely coated, and there shouldn't be 
any issues for training.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sweet! Shion-san, isn't that awesome~!

There was something about how naturally 
she supported others that brought a sense 
of comfort just watching her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what's with that out of nowhere? 
Who's what doing what now?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Your words, of course, Jordan-san. How 
should I put it... your words really just 
hit home in a good way.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Today too... I'm really glad I asked you 
to help with my nails, Jordan-san.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Which means...? Wait? I'm being praised... 
right?

A hidden talent she wasn't even aware of 
herself. Surely, it will continue to help 
those around her in the days ahead.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where'd this come from all of a 
sudden?!

I explained that being able to naturally 
find the good in others and genuinely 
respect them for it is no easy feat.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you said everything I was thinking.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, you're the one who's 
incredible, Jordan-san. So...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uh, ah, thanks...? ...Ugh, why does this 
feel so ticklish~~~~~~!!
